item.title: Manic EMU v2.0.1
item.description:
Manic EMU 2.0.1 | ManicEMU.v2.0.1.SideloadJIT
- Added WonderSwan support - Added NAOMI, Atomiswave, and System SP arcade support - Added Flash support · Skin button binding · Hardware keyboard input · Software keyboard input · Touch input - Built-in, self-contained JIT — no external debugger required - Added Slow Motion - Improved GameCube and Wii performance - GameCube now supports multi-disc games - Improved Wii motion controls - Simulate the Wii IR pointer by touch - Add games from other emulators via a link - Fixed some arcade systems that wouldn’t run - Fixed Dreamcast games running too fast - Fixed PSP crashes - Added NDS lid open/close - Improved rotation: with orientation lock on in Control Center, the app no longer snaps back to portrait - In-game shortcut tips can now be turned off - Landscape library can disable carousel style - Smoother landscape carousel scrolling - MultiDisc Helper supports more formats - Hardware keyboard input for Symbian, Amiga, and C64 - Added RomM support · LAN self-hosted servers only · Sync only for games imported from RomM · Manual sync only, from the service card’s long-press menu · Pull ROMs, covers, metadata, manuals, and game saves - Fixed a launch timeout that could quit the app on older devices - N64 now supports ROMs larger than 64 MB
